verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a firewall that blocks attacks, scrapers, and unwanted traffic through custom rules, IP blocking, and managed rulesets, plus an invisible bot check for sensitive routes. The evidence never says DDoS mitigation exists or that the WAF applies to every request by default. A community comment that DDoS traffic can go undetected and run up large bills is anecdotal, so it lowers confidence rather than establishing a dispute. Missing for 10: documented DDoS protection, evidence that protection is on by default for all requests, and independent hands-on corroboration of the WAF.
